title: Local pure triples determine a total-complex associator
statement: Let J be a small site and R a commutative ring sheaf with independently sized coefficients; assume additive sheafification and the identification of its local equivalences with locally bijective maps [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For any integer cochain complexes P,Q,N of R-module sheaves, let a:Tot(Tot(P,Q),N)≅Tot(P,Tot(Q,N)) [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Assume that for every p+q=pq, q+t=qt, pq+t=n=p+qt, every site object V, and local sections x of P^p, y of Q^q, z of N^t, a in degree n maps the nested canonical tensor generator (x tensor y) tensor z to x tensor (y tensor z). Then the hom of a is exactly the native complex tensor associator hom. This statement needs no flatness or derived localization assumptions.

proof.text: A map from the iterated sheaf tensor is detected by its values on all local pure triples. Tensor the inner sheafification unit with the third module and sheafify. Tensor preserves local equivalences, so this map is invertible. Cancel it and the tensor/sheafification isomorphisms. Apply the sheafification adjunction and sectionwise threefold tensor extensionality; naturality of the unit and moduleTmul_map identify the tests with local pure triples.

proof.text: Test the complex morphisms on every triple coproduct summand. The assumed generator formula for a and complexConstraints.associator give equal values on pure triples, so the detection criterion identifies their restrictions. Triple coproduct extensionality and degreewise extensionality identify the maps.

theorem coefficientAssociator_eq_native
    (P Q N : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ)
    (a : (coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj
        ((coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj (P, Q), N) ≅
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj
        (P, (coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj (Q, N)))
    (ha : ∀ (p q t pq qt n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = pq) (hqt : q + t = qt)
      (hn : pq + t = n) (hn' : p + qt = n) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
      (x : (P.X p).val.obj V) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj V) (z : (N.X t).val.obj V),
      (a.hom.f n).val.app V
        (coefficientTensorGenerator.{r, c, v} J R
          ((coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj (P, Q)) N pq t n hn V
          (coefficientTensorGenerator.{r, c, v} J R P Q p q pq hpq V x y) z) =
      coefficientTensorGenerator.{r, c, v} J R P
        ((coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).obj (Q, N)) p qt n hn' V x
        (coefficientTensorGenerator.{r, c, v} J R Q N q t qt hqt V y z)) :
    let := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients.{c, v, max c v r} R
    let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    a.hom = (α_ P Q N).hom
